heroData.title: EOR & PEO in Chad
heroData.subtitle: Comprehensive guide to EOR & PEO in Chad
heroData.description: Detailed insights and providers for EOR & PEO in Chad.

steps.title: Define Role
steps.description: Establish the job description and salary in XAF. Ensure role isn't 'reserved' for nationals (rare, but check sectoral rules).

steps.title: KYC & Documents
steps.description: Collect Passport/ID, CV, and criminal record (Casier Judiciaire). For expats, a work permit (Permis de Travail) is mandatory before starting.

steps.title: Medical Check
steps.description: Pre-employment medical exam at a recognized occupational health center (Médecine du Travail) is mandatory.

steps.title: Contract Issuance
steps.description: Drafting the CDD (Fixed-Term) or CDI (Indefinite) in French. Must explicitly state the 39-hour work week.

steps.title: ONAPE Declaration
steps.description: Register the hiring with the Office National pour la Promotion de l'Emploi (ONAPE).

steps.title: CNPS Registration
steps.description: Enroll employee in the Caisse Nationale de Prévoyance Sociale (CNPS) within 3 days of hiring.

steps.title: Payroll Setup
steps.description: Configure statutory deductions (IRPP, CNPS) and define the payment method (Bank Transfer recommended).

items.title: Standard Hours
items.description: The legal work week is 39 hours for non-agricultural sectors. Often organized as Mon-Fri (7.5h) and Sat morning.

items.title: Overtime
items.description: Overtime is paid at +25% for the first 8 hours and +50% beyond that. Sundays/Holidays trigger +100%.

items.title: Probation
items.description: Up to 3 months for executives (Cadres), renewable once. 1 month for employees. Termination during probation is notice-free.

items.title: Leave Entitlement
items.description: 2 working days per month of service (24 days/year). Increases with seniority (Ancienté) after 5 years.

items.title: Public Holidays
items.description: Chad observes approx 13 public holidays (Fêtes légales) including religious festivals.

items.title: Grounds
items.description: Must be justified (Real and Serious Cause). prohibited grounds include union activity or discrimination.

items.title: Notice Period
items.description: 1 month for non-executives. 3 months for executives. Can be paid in lieu (Préavis non effectué).

items.title: Severance
items.description: Indemnité de licenciement is legally required for employees with >1 year service. Approx 20% of monthly wage per year.

items.title: Procedure
items.description: Written notification required. For economic dismissal, labor inspector authorization is needed.

faqs.question: Minimum Wage?
faqs.answer: SMIG is approx 60,000 XAF (agriculture may differ). Regularly updated.

faqs.question: Foreign workers?
faqs.answer: Require a Work Permit from ONAPE. Quatas may apply in some industries.

faqs.question: Language?
faqs.answer: French and Arabic are official. French is the business language.

items.description: Landlocked. Goods arrive via Douala (Cameroon) or Cotonou (Benin). Transit takes weeks.

items.title: Banking

items.title: Hierarchy

items.title: Greetings

items.title: Friday/Prayer

items.title: Tea Culture

steps.title: Timesheets
steps.description: Collect attendance records and overtime hours by the 25th of the month.

steps.title: Calculations
steps.description: Apply IRPP (Progressive Tax) and CNPS deductions. Check for ceiling limits (500k XAF for CNPS).

steps.title: Validation
steps.description: Approve payroll register. Ensure net pay matches bank file.

steps.title: Payment
steps.description: Disburse net salaries via local banks (Ecobank, Orabank, CBT) in XAF.

steps.title: Filing
steps.description: Submit declarations to CNPS and Tax Authority (DGI) by the 10th-15th of the following month.

rows: Pension share. Capped at 500,000 XAF salary base.
Income Tax. Progressive bands (0-10.5M XAF annual).

faqs.question: 13th Month?
faqs.answer: Customary in N'Djamena for professional roles, but not law.

faqs.question: Pay Slips?
faqs.answer: Mandatory. Must show all deductions clearly.

faqs.question: Bonuses?
faqs.answer: Performance bonuses are taxable unless specifically exempted.

heroData.title: Incorporation in Chad
heroData.subtitle: Comprehensive guide to Incorporation in Chad
heroData.description: Detailed insights and providers for Incorporation in Chad.

steps.title: Notary Public
steps.description: Drafting the statutes. Unlike some OHADA countries, a notary is practically mandatory in Chad.

steps.title: Capital Deposit
steps.description: Deposit 100,000 XAF (minimum) at a bank (e.g., Ecobank) and get certificate.

steps.title: ANIE (Guichet Unique)
steps.description: Submit dossier to the Agence Nationale des Investissements. They handle RCCM, NIF, and Stats.

steps.title: Registration
steps.description: Obtain the RCCM (Company Registry) number.

steps.title: Publication
steps.description: Publish in the national journal 'Info-Tchad' or other approved gazette.

steps.title: Tax Activation
steps.description: Visit the Direction Générale des Impôts (DGI) to activate the NIF and determine tax regime.

items.title: SARL
items.description: Standard LLC. Min capital 100k XAF. Liability limited to contributions.

items.title: SA
items.description: Public Corp. Min capital 10M XAF. Board of Directors required.

items.title: Succursale
items.description: Branch office. Easy to set up but tax status is same as local entity. Converting to subsidiary required after 2 years usually.

rows: Varies by capital. Statutory scale applies.

items.description: Electricity reliability and internet speed (though improving via fiber) can impact digital delivery.

items.title: Regulatory
items.description: OHADA framework provides legal certainty for commercial contracts.

items.title: Language
items.description: French is the operational language. Arabic is widely spoken.

steps.title: Identify Needs
steps.description: Clearly define deliverables.

steps.title: Verify Status
steps.description: Check strictly for tax compliance (Quitus Fiscal).

steps.title: Negotiate
steps.description: Agree on net vs gross pricing (TTC vs HT).

steps.title: Contract
steps.description: Sign a formal Convention de Service.

items.title: ANIE
items.description: Agence Nationale des Investissements et des Exportations.

items.title: ONAPE
items.description: Office National pour la Promotion de l'Emploi.

items.title: NIF
items.description: Numéro d'Identification Fiscale.

items.title: Patente
items.description: Annual professional tax.

faqs.question: Security?
faqs.answer: N'Djamena has security protocols. Border regions with Sudan/CAR may be restricted. Consult embassies.

faqs.question: Currency?
faqs.answer: XAF (CFA Franc). Fixed rate to Euro.

faqs.question: Visa?
faqs.answer: Business visas required. Letter of Invitation often needed.

items.title: Oil Economy
items.description: Economy heavily dependent on oil exports. Price fluctuations impact FX availability.

items.title: Informal Sector
items.description: Large informal economy. Formal businesses bear high tax scrutiny.

items.title: Logistics
items.description: Landlocked. Goods arrive via Douala (Cameroon) or Cotonou (Benin). Transit takes weeks.

items.title: Banking
items.description: Several international banks presence (Ecobank, UBA, CBE, SGT).

items.title: Hierarchy
items.description: Respect for elders and seniority is paramount.

items.title: Greetings
items.description: Handshakes are common. Prolonged greetings asking about family are polite.

items.title: Friday/Prayer
items.description: Friday afternoon may be slow due to Jummah prayers.

items.title: Tea Culture
items.description: Sharing tea is a sign of hospitality and often accompanies meetings.
